changelog.title: Aegis v1.0.1 — Multiplatform Desktop & CI Automation

entries.title: Automated Multiplatform Builds:
entries.desc: Full CI/CD compilation matrix producing release binaries for Android (APK), Linux (tarball), Windows (x64 zip), and macOS (universal zip).

entries.title: Dynamic Checksum Verification:
entries.desc: Real-time SHA256 integrity checks, exact file sizes, and 1-click clipboard hashing on web download page directly from GitHub Release digests.

entries.title: Tag-Driven Dynamic Versioning:
entries.desc: App versions on Settings screen automatically synchronize to git release tags at compile-time without manual code updates.

entries.title: Windows MSVC Coroutine Deprecation:
entries.desc: Configured _SILENCE_EXPERIMENTAL_COROUTINE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS to resolve MSVC STL1011 static assertion errors on Windows 64-bit runners.

entries.title: macOS Ad-Hoc Signing:
entries.desc: Resolved compilation CLI flags and enabled ad-hoc code signing for seamless macOS Universal execution.

entries.title: Multiplatform Documentation:
entries.desc: Comprehensive release setup guide and troubleshooting reference for automated multi-OS builds.

entries.title: Interactive VT100 SSH Terminal:
entries.desc: Hardware-accelerated true cell buffer with curses/TUI support (htop, vim, tmux), dynamic SIGWINCH viewport reflow, and 4 Hacker Themes.

entries.title: Native SFTP v3 Remote Explorer:
entries.desc: Live breadcrumbs, in-app remote text/config editor, upload/download streams, and dotfile visibility toggle.

entries.title: 17 CIS Linux Hardening Benchmarks:
entries.desc: Automated compliance checks, dynamic Letter Grades (A+ to F), and 1-tap executable remediation playbook generator.

entries.title: AbuseIPDB Global Threat Intelligence:
entries.desc: Automated Tor exit node and Botnet C2 detection with private subnet filtering.

entries.title: Zero-Knowledge Biometric Vault:
entries.desc: Hardware-backed keystore integration (Fingerprint, Face Unlock, and Keychain) with encrypted local storage.

entries.title: Firebase Cloud Messaging:
entries.desc: Instant mobile push alert dispatcher hooked directly into Fail2ban auth.log threat incidents.

entries.title: Ergonomic Mobile Keypad:
entries.desc: Triple-dot action menu eliminating text overflow on small screens.
